Title: User Authentication
User Story: As a user, I want to securely register and login so that my workspace and data remain protected.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. User can register with email and password. 2. Login with valid credentials. 3. JWT token generated after login. 4. Logout functionality works correctly.
Functional Requirements: Implement Supabase authentication. Secure password hashing. Role-based access control.
Non-Functional Requirements: Authentication response time < 2s. Secure token storage. Support 1000+ concurrent users.

Title: Workspace Creation
User Story: As a user, I want to create a workspace so that I can collaborate with my team.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. User can create workspace. 2. Unique workspace ID generated. 3. Workspace visible in dashboard.
Functional Requirements: Backend API for workspace CRUD. Store workspace metadata in PostgreSQL.

Title: Real-Time Code Editing
User Story: As a developer, I want real-time collaborative editing so that multiple users can code together.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Changes sync instantly. 2. No data conflicts. 3. Multiple cursors visible.
Functional Requirements: Integrate Monaco Editor. Implement Yjs CRDT sync. WebSocket communication.
Non-Functional Requirements: Latency < 200ms. Support 20+ concurrent users per workspace.

Title: Task Management System
User Story: As a team member, I want to create and assign tasks so that work is organized.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Create/edit/delete tasks. 2. Assign members. 3. Task status tracking.
Functional Requirements: CRUD APIs for tasks. Link tasks to workspace.

Title: Integrated Chat
User Story: As a user, I want in-workspace chat so that I can communicate without external tools.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Send/receive messages instantly. 2. Messages stored in DB. 3. Chat history loads on refresh.
Functional Requirements: WebSocket-based chat service. Store messages in PostgreSQL.

Title: AI Code Suggestions
User Story: As a developer, I want AI suggestions so that I can write code faster.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. User can request suggestion. 2. AI returns context-aware response. 3. Suggestion inserted into editor.
Functional Requirements: Integrate HuggingFace API. Backend prompt processing.
Non-Functional Requirements: AI response < 5s. Secure API calls. Rate limit handling.

Title: Shared Terminal Execution
User Story: As a team member, I want a shared terminal so that we can execute code together.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Terminal opens in browser. 2. Commands execute successfully. 3. Output visible to all users.
Functional Requirements: Integrate WebSocket terminal service. Secure sandbox execution.
Non-Functional Requirements: Command execution < 3s. Isolated environment per workspace.

Title: Role-Based Access Control
User Story: As a workspace admin, I want to manage user roles so that permissions are controlled.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Assign roles (Admin/Member). 2. Restrict actions by role.
Functional Requirements: Implement RBAC logic in backend. Enforce DB-level RLS.
Non-Functional Requirements: Unauthorized access prevented. Secure RLS enforcement.

Title: Multi-Tenant Database Isolation
User Story: As a system, I must isolate workspace data to ensure security.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Workspace data separated. 2. No cross-workspace data leaks.
Non-Functional Requirements: Zero data leakage. Secure tenant isolation.

Title: Deployment & Cloud Hosting
User Story: As a product team, we want cloud deployment so that users can access platform online.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. App deployed on cloud VM. 2. HTTPS enabled. 3. Database hosted securely.
Functional Requirements: Deploy Node.js server. Configure Nginx and SSL.
Non-Functional Requirements: 99% uptime. Secure HTTPS. Auto-restart on crash.
